summary.goal: Factory functions for all 30+ source preset configurations across 5 authority tiers. Each preset defines: name, adapter_type, description, required_inputs, optional_inputs, defaults, and channel_authority score. Presets provide zero-config source setup — users select a preset and fill in required inputs.

acceptance_criteria.description: SourcePreset schema defines name, adapter_type, description, required_inputs, optional_inputs, defaults, and channel_authority
Tier 1 presets (highest authority): support tickets, surveys, user interviews
Tier 2 presets: GitHub issues/PRs, app store reviews, review sites, analytics events, in-app feedback
Tier 3 presets: Slack, Discord, Teams, CRM notes, sales call transcripts
Tier 4 presets: Reddit, Hacker News, Twitter/X, RSS feeds, web scraping
Tier 5 presets (lowest authority): manual entry, document upload, CSV import, Zapier webhook
All presets retrievable via a registry with catalog endpoint support

steps.title: Define SourcePreset schema
steps.description: Create Zod schema and TypeScript type for SourcePreset: name (string), adapter_type (AdapterType enum), description (string), required_inputs (array of {key, label, type, description}), optional_inputs (array of {key, label, type, description, default?}), defaults (Record<string, unknown> for pre-configured adapter settings), channel_authority (number 0-1 representing source tier weight). Export InputField type for required/optional input definitions.

steps.title: Implement Tier 1 presets (support, surveys, interviews)
steps.description: Create factory functions for highest-authority presets (channel_authority: 0.9-1.0): createSupportTicketPreset (poll_api, requires: API endpoint, auth token), createSurveyPreset (poll_api, requires: survey platform API key), createUserInterviewPreset (push, requires: none — manual upload of transcripts, speaker-aware chunking default). Each returns a complete SourcePreset with sensible defaults for polling intervals, pagination, and data mapping.

steps.title: Implement Tier 2 presets (github, appstores, reviews, analytics, in-app)
steps.description: Create factory functions for Tier 2 presets (channel_authority: 0.7-0.85): createGitHubIssuesPreset, createGitHubPRsPreset (poll_api, requires: repo, token), createAppStorePreset (poll_api, requires: app ID), createPlayStorePreset (poll_api, requires: package name), createG2ReviewPreset, createTrustpilotPreset (poll_api), createAnalyticsEventPreset (webhook), createInAppFeedbackPreset (webhook, HMAC verification). Include appropriate polling intervals and endpoint templates.

steps.title: Implement Tier 3 presets (slack, discord, teams, CRM, sales)
steps.description: Create factory functions for Tier 3 presets (channel_authority: 0.5-0.65): createSlackPreset (poll_api, requires: bot token, channel IDs), createDiscordPreset (poll_api, requires: bot token, channel IDs), createTeamsPreset (poll_api, requires: webhook URL), createCRMNotesPreset (poll_api, configurable for Salesforce/HubSpot), createSalesCallPreset (push, speaker-aware chunking for call transcripts). These sources have moderate authority — conversational context that may contain signal.

steps.title: Implement Tier 4 presets (reddit, hackernews, twitter, RSS, web)
steps.description: Create factory functions for Tier 4 presets (channel_authority: 0.3-0.45): createRedditPreset (poll_api, requires: subreddit names), createHackerNewsPreset (poll_api, requires: search terms), createTwitterPreset (poll_api, requires: API key, search queries), createRSSPreset (poll_api, requires: feed URLs), createWebScraperPreset (poll_api, requires: target URLs, CSS selectors). Lower authority because sources are public and unvetted. Longer polling intervals to respect rate limits.

steps.title: Implement Tier 5 presets (manual, document, CSV, zapier)
steps.description: Create factory functions for Tier 5 presets (channel_authority: 0.1-0.25): createManualEntryPreset (push, no inputs required — signals created via API), createDocumentUploadPreset (push, recursive chunking for uploaded documents), createCSVImportPreset (push, requires: column mapping configuration), createZapierWebhookPreset (webhook, HMAC verification, generic payload normalization). Lowest authority tier — least structured, most manual.

steps.title: Add preset registry and catalog endpoint
steps.description: Build PresetRegistry that collects all preset factory functions into a searchable registry. Methods: getAll() returns all presets grouped by tier, getByName(name) returns a specific preset, getByAdapterType(type) filters by adapter type. Export getPresetCatalog() that returns the full catalog as a serializable array for the GET /api/cultivate/presets endpoint. Each entry includes name, description, tier, adapter_type, required_inputs, and optional_inputs (but not defaults/secrets).
